name: Tsuku x Tsuku Onee-san Nurse ni Tsukusareru Game
original_name: つく×つく　お姉さんナースに尽くされるゲーム
source:
Takeshi is a rookie male nurse. One day, his coworkers, Mao, Reiko, Asuka and Yukie, start a battle for him. "If you make Takeshi fall in love with you, you'll win. That's all." The battle starts without Takeshi's permission. Well, what will happen to him...? 

[From ErogeShop]
